author: nickyeow

english.text: From now on, let's keep in touch.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 hau6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3 aa3。
text: 我哋以後要保持聯絡呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you go by bus, you can get there in about one-third of the time.

jyutping: nei5 daap3 baa1 si2 heoi3 ge3 waa2，ho2 ji5 haan1 faan2 saam1 fan1 ji6 si4 gaan3。
text: 你搭巴士去嘅話，可以慳返三分二時間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They were stuck for hours in a traffic jam.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sak1 ce1 sak1 zo2 gei2 lap1 zung1。
text: 佢哋塞車塞咗幾粒鐘。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What would it cost to have this chair repaired?

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa2 sau1 lei5 ne1 zoeng1 dang3 jiu3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3？
text: 我想問吓修理呢張凳要幾多錢呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I didn't understand in the least what he said.

jyutping: keoi5 gong2 di1 je5 ngo5 jat1 geoi3 dou1 teng1 m4 ming4。
text: 佢講啲嘢我一句都聽唔明。

author: kaenif

english.text: Who did it?

jyutping: bin1 go3 zou6 gaa3？
text: 邊個做架？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am afraid that you will get lost.

jyutping: ngo5 geng1 nei5 wui5 dong6 sat1 lou6。
text: 我驚你會蕩失路。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you free this weekend?

jyutping: nei5 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 luk6 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3？
text: 你今個禮拜六日得唔得閒呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Some people think I'm weak-willed.

jyutping: jau5 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 ngo5 ji3 zi3 hou2 bok6 joek6。
text: 有啲人覺得我意志好薄弱。

author: kaenif

english.text: I broke his heart, but I love him.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 sam1，daan6 hai6 ngo5 oi3 keoi5。
text: 我傷咗佢嘅心，但係我愛佢。

author: kaenif

english.text: It's too big.

jyutping: taai3 daai6 laa3。
text: 太大喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Single people enjoy more freedom to do what they want and enjoy living a less restricted social life.

jyutping: daan1 san1 ge3 jan4 jau5 gang3 gaa1 daai6 ge3 zi6 jau4 heoi3 syun2 zaak6 zi6 gei2 soeng2 zou6 ge3 si6，se5 gaau1 m4 sai2 cyu3 cyu3 sau6 dou3 cuk1 bok3。
text: 單身嘅人有更加大嘅自由去選擇自己想做嘅事，社交唔使處處受到束縛。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He plays the piano better than I do.

jyutping: keoi5 taan4 kam4 taan4 dak1 hou2 gwo3 ngo5。
text: 佢彈琴彈得好過我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This is all that I know.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 dou3 ge3 zau6 hai6 dak1 gam3 do1。
text: 我知道嘅就係得咁多。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Our store is large.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 pou3 tau2 hou2 daai6 gaan1。
text: 我哋間舖頭好大間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Applications are due by Monday.

jyutping: sing1 kei4 jat1 zit6 zi2 bou3 meng2。
text: 星期一截止報名。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Intelligent people are often arrogant.

jyutping: di1 lek1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 cyun3。
text: 啲叻嘅人通常都好寸。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I could not convince him of his mistake.

jyutping: ngo5 gong2 gik6 keoi5 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2。
text: 我講極佢都唔信佢做錯咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What color are you going to paint the ceiling?

jyutping: nei5 nam2 zyu6 zoeng1 go3 tin1 faa1 baan2 jau1 zou6 me1 sik1 aa3？
text: 你諗住將個天花板髹做咩色呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can I borrow it?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 lai4 aa3？
text: 可唔可以借嚟呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.

jyutping: keoi5 ceng2 zo2 go3 si1 gaa1 zing1 taam3 lai4 gaam1 si6 zyu6 keoi5 lou5 gung1。
text: 佢請咗個私家偵探嚟監視住佢老公。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: He passed away the day before yesterday.

jyutping: keoi4 cin4 jat6 zau2 zo2。
text: 渠前日走咗。

english.text: In winter, the windows were sometimes quite frozen over. But then the boy and the girl would warm copper pennies on the stove, and hold the warm pennies against the frozen pane; there would be very soon a little round hole through which they could peep, and the soft bright eyes of the little boy and girl would beam through the hole at each window as they looked at each other.

jyutping: hai2 dung1 tin1，di1 coeng1 jau5 si4 wui5 gei2 dung3 , ji4 naam4 zai2 tung4 neoi5 zai2 ge3 jau4 jyun5 ming4 loeng6 ge3 ngaan5 zing1，dong1 keoi5 dei6 wu6 soeng1 mong6 zyu6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 si4 hau6，wui5 tau3 gwo3 mui5 go3 coeng1 hau2 ge3 dung6 se6 ceot1 lai4。daan6 hai6 zi1 hau6 go3 naam4 zai2 tung4 go3 neoi5 zai2 wui5 hai2 lou4 soeng6 min6 nyun5 tung4 bin6 si6，jin4 hau6 zoeng1 go3 nyun5 bin6 si6 pou5 zyu6 dung3 zo2 ge3 bo1 lei4；；hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 jau5 go3 jyun4 jing4 ge3 sai3 lung1，keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 tau3 gwo3 ni1 go3 lung1 tau1 kwai1，ji4 dong1 keoi5 dei6 wu6 soeng1 mong6 zyu6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 si4 hau6，naam4 zai2 tung4 neoi5 zai2 ge3 jau4 wo4 ming4 loeng6 ge3 ngaan5 zing1 wui5 cyun1 gwo3 mui5 go3 coeng1 hau2 ge3 lung1。
text: 喺冬天，啲窗有時會幾凍 , 而男仔同女仔嘅柔軟明亮嘅眼睛，當佢哋互相望住對方嘅時候，會透過每個窗口嘅洞射出嚟。但係之後個男仔同個女仔會喺爐上面暖銅便士，然後將個暖便士抱住凍咗嘅玻璃；；好快就會有個圓形嘅細窿，佢哋可以透過呢個窿偷窺，而當佢哋互相望住對方嘅時候，男仔同女仔嘅柔和明亮嘅眼睛會穿過每個窗口嘅窿。

english.text: Many people easily understand the injustice of the current language situation in the world where English dominates. But they also see the collective advantages, as for example a relatively good and direct communication between intellectuals and leaders of different languages through the English language, and the personal advantages as their own knowledge of the English language. About a neutral language such as Esperanto, one does not know much and does not seek information.

jyutping: hou2 do1 jan4 hou2 jung4 ji6 ming4 baak6 jing1 man2 zyu2 dou6 ge3 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 jin6 si4 ge3 jyu5 jin4 zong6 fong3 hai6 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 jik6 dou1 tai2 dou2 zaap6 tai2 ge3 jau1 sai3，lai6 jyu4 zi1 sik1 fan6 zi2 tung4 m4 tung4 jyu5 jin4 ge3 ling5 zau6 zi1 gaan1 tau3 gwo3 jing1 man2 jyu5 jin4 zeon3 hang4 soeng1 deoi3 loeng4 hou2 tung4 zik6 zip3 ge3 kau1 tung1，tung4 maai4 go3 jan4 ge3 kau1 tung1 jau1 dim2 hai6 zi6 gei2 deoi3 jing1 man2 ge3 jing6 sik1 gwaan1 jyu1 jat1 zung2 zung1 laap6 ge3 jyu5 jin4，lai6 jyu4 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，jat1 go3 jan4 m4 do1 sik1，jik6 dou1 m4 wui5 cam4 kau4 zi1 seon3。
text: 好多人好容易明白英文主導嘅世界上現時嘅語言狀況係唔公平嘅，但係佢哋亦都睇到集體嘅優勢，例如知識分子同唔同語言嘅領袖之間透過英文語言進行相對良好同直接嘅溝通，同埋個人嘅溝通 優點係自己對英文嘅認識關於一種中立嘅語言，例如世界語，一個人唔多識，亦都唔會尋求資訊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the morning of the 9th of November of 2021, as I entered the cafe, a muscular white man with black hair in grey and blue clothing entered before me. As it was full inside, I had to drink my iced oat milk at a table outside. Then, I ate two slices of pizza at my friend Rose's pizzeria. Nearby, a big labourer exclaimed, "You think the Netherlands is a different province..."

jyutping: hai2 2021 nin4 11 jyut6 9 hou6 ge3 ziu1 zou2，dong1 ngo5 zeon3 jap6 gaa3 fe1 gun2 go2 zan6，jat1 go3 gei1 juk6 zong3 zong3 ge3 baak6 jan4 naam4 jan2，hak1 faat3，zoek3 zyu6 fui1 laam4 sik1 ge3 saam1，hai2 ngo5 cin4 min6 jap6 lai4，jan1 wai6 jap6 min6 ji5 ging1 mun5 zo2，ngo5 jiu3 hai2 ceot1 min2 zoeng1 toi2 dou6 jam2 ngo5 ge3 bing1 jin3 mak6 naai5。jin4 hau6，ngo5 hai2 ngo5 pang4 jau5 Rose ge3 bok6 beng2 dim3 sik6 zo2 loeng5 pin3 bok6 beng2。hai2 fu6 gan6，jau5 go3 daai6 lou4 gung1 daai6 giu3：「nei5 ji5 wai4 ho4 laan1 hai6 m4 tung4 ge3 saang2 fan6 laa3 … … 」
text: 喺2021年11月9號嘅朝早，當我進入咖啡館嗰陣，一個肌肉壯壯嘅白人男人，黑髮，着住灰藍色嘅衫，喺我前面入嚟，因為入面已經滿咗，我要喺出面張枱度飲我嘅冰燕麥奶。然後，我喺我朋友 Rose 嘅薄餅店食咗兩片薄餅。喺附近，有個大勞工大叫：「你以為荷蘭係唔同嘅省份喇 … … 」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the morning of the 18th of May of 2025, with cloudy skies interspersed with blue spaces. I went walking to Tim Hortons café to enjoy a hash brown with an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk. Upon my return home, Eric, Kathy, Pia, and Minda were already awake. Eric and Kathy are fixing the new screen at the kitchen's back door. I talked a bit with Minda: Apparently, she and her new black American husband shuttle between Ohio and Cavite in the Philippines. We know that in Cavite, there is Chabacano, Philippine Creole Spanish, that is a different dialect from Zamboanga City's. Meanwhile, I ate more of the tiramisù, leftover from last night. My cousin Eve made it. Moreover, in the morning, I have been looking over my Native Indian documents in linguistics, like California's Shasta, etc.

jyutping: hai2 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 18 hou6 ge3 ziu1 zou2，tin1 hung1 do1 wan4，cyun1 caap3 zyu6 laam4 sik1 ge3 hung1 gaan1，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1，hoeng2 jung6 jat1 go3 haa1 si6 kei4 gaa3 fe1，pui3 maai4 jat1 bui1 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 baak3 zoek3 caa4。ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6， Eric 、 Kathy 、 Pia tung4 Minda ji5 ging1 seng2 zo2。aai1 lei5 hak1 tung4 hoi2 sai1 hai2 cyu4 fong2 hau6 mun2 zing2 gan2 go3 san1 ge3 ping4 mok6，ngo5 tung4 ming4 daat6 king1 zo2 di1 je5：geoi3 gong2，keoi5 tung4 keoi5 san1 ge3 mei5 gwok3 haak1 jan4 lou5 gung1 hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1 ge3 ngo4 hoi6 ngo4 zau1 tung4 kaa1 wai4 dak6 zi1 gaan1 cyun1 so1。ngo5 dei6 zi1 dou3 hai2 kaa1 wai4 dak6，jau5 Chabacano ，fei1 leot6 ban1 hak1 lei5 ou3 ji5 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man2，ni1 go3 hai6 tung4 saam1 bou2 on1 gaa1 sing4 ge3 m4 tung4 ge3 fong1 jin4，tung4 si4，ngo5 sik6 zo2 gang3 do1 ge3 tai4 laai1 mai5 si1，hai6 kam4 maan5 zing6 dai1 ge3，ji4 ce2，hai2 ziu1 zou2，ngo5 jat1 zik6 tai2 gan2 ngo5 ge3 jan3 dou6 jyun4 zyu6 man4 jyu5 jin4 hok6 man4 gin2，lai6 jyu4 gaa1 zau1 ge3 Shasta 。
text: 喺2025年5月18號嘅朝早，天空多雲，穿插住藍色嘅空間，我去咗行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳，享用一個哈士奇咖啡，配埋一杯配燕麥奶嘅伯爵茶。我返到屋企嗰陣， Eric 、 Kathy 、 Pia 同 Minda 已經醒咗。埃里克同凱西喺廚房後門整緊個新嘅屏幕，我同明達傾咗啲嘢：據講，佢同佢新嘅美國黑人老公喺菲律賓嘅俄亥俄州同卡維特之間穿梭。我哋知道喺卡維特，有 Chabacano ，菲律賓克里奧爾西班牙文，呢個係同三寶安加城嘅唔同嘅方言，同時，我食咗更多嘅提拉米斯，係琴晚剩低嘅，而且，喺朝早，我一直睇緊我嘅印度原住民語言學文件，例如加州嘅 Shasta 。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The fact that you think LGBT people have chosen to be LGBT is insulting to me. What exactly have we chosen? Have we chosen for us to be mocked by others or break our families apart? For us to not get apartments rented or jobs? Do you believe it's pleasing for us to see you discussing whether we deserve rights?

jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 LGBT jan4 gaan2 zou6 LGBT ni1 go3 si6 sat6 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 mou5 juk6。ngo5 dei6 gau3 ging2 gaan2 zo2 di1 me1？ngo5 dei6 hai6 mai6 syun2 zaak6 zo2 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 zaau1 siu3，ding6 hai6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gaa1 ting4 fan1 lit6？wai6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 lo2 gung1 jyu6 zou1 waak6 ze2 gung1 zok3？nei5 soeng1 seon3 ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou2 nei5 dei6 tou2 leon6 ngo5 dei6 hai6 mai6 jing1 goi1 dak1 dou3 kyun4 lei6 hai6 jat1 gin6 ling6 jan4 gou1 hing3 ge3 si6？
text: 你覺得 LGBT 人揀做 LGBT 呢個事實對我嚟講係侮辱。我哋究竟揀咗啲咩？我哋係咪選擇咗畀其他人嘲笑，定係令我哋嘅家庭分裂？為咗我哋唔攞公寓租或者工作？你相信我哋見到你哋討論我哋係咪應該得到權利係一件令人高興嘅事？
